headline: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's alleged affair with suspected Chinese spy
summary: Nvidia opened an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive reportedly recruited by Chinese intelligence to spy on him. Huang admitted the affair in a staff memo, Congress summoned him over espionage concerns, Nvidia's shares fell, and figures including Elon Musk and Donald Trump voiced support. Outlets differ on whether to call the relationship an affair and on which papers first reported it.
